stem: How did the National Organization for Women (NOW) affect the feminist movement during the 1970s?

options.label: A
options.text: By opposing the Supreme Court's Roe v. Wade decision legalizing abortion

options.label: B
options.text: By opposing laws granting tax credits for stay-at-home mothers

options.label: C
options.text: By supporting scholarship programs available through beauty pageants

options.label: D
